headline: Western and Central Fronts Flare as Turnover Slows in Stlican Shelf
war_summary: Since the last edition, combat has intensified across central and western sectors while the furious base turnover in Stlican Shelf finally paused, yielding no ownership changes in the past two hours. In contrast, Weathered Expanse remains the war's most volatile theater, registering six base transitions and over thirty-four hundred casualties in two hours across contested strongpoints including Wightwalk and Shattered Advance. Western fighting continues unabated in Stonecradle, where The Cord and Trammel Pool saw three fresh transitions amid more than thirteen hundred combined casualties, leaving the region split with one base in ruins. Nearby, Farranac Coast logged three additional base events and over two thousand casualties in the two-hour window centered on Transient Valley. Linn of Mercy has reignited with three base shifts between Ulster Falls and The Long Whine, while Viper Pit sustained three further actions at Blackthroat. Further inland, Callahan's Passage recorded no structural flips over the past six hours despite sustaining a massive acceleration of over twenty-five hundred casualties in the last two hours alone.
